coin.title: Dutch Water Defence Lines 10 Euro Coin 2025 Gold Proof (PF69)
coin.description: #html-body [data-pb-style=M8BECKE]{justify-content:flex-start;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background-position:left top;background-size:cover;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-attachment:scroll}A gold coin with an official NGC grade? The Dutch Water Defence Lines 10 Euro Coin 2025 Gold Proof has been graded PF69 by NGC, one of the highest possible grades. PF69 means this Gold coin was struck with virtually imperceptible imperfections. This Gold commemorative coin comes in a transparent, official NGC case.
